promised_vs_delivered.delivered: Later call C3 revised FY27 credit cost guidance to 3.0-4.0% and C1 maintained 3-4%; FY27 full year is ongoing.
C4 reported foreign borrowings at 24.3% towards 25-30% target by FY28; target horizon has not elapsed.
C1 retained FY27 AUM growth guidance of 20-25% with Q2 FY27 YoY growth at 19.5%; FY27 is ongoing.
C1 raised FY27 NIM guidance to 14.4-14.7% after Q2 FY27 NIM expanded to 15.1%; full year pending.
C1 lowered FY27 cost to income guidance to 29-30% from 33-35% as costs remained controlled; full year pending.
C1 raised FY27 ROA guidance to 5.2-5.8% from 4.0-4.8% following strong H1 performance; full year pending.
C1 raised FY27 ROE guidance to 21-24% from 16-20% after strong H1 FY27 profitability; full year pending.
Management reiterated commitment to INR 50,000 Crore AUM by CY2028; target period is ongoing.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management reported highest quarterly net profit of INR 502 Crore in Q2 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Sep 2026 PAT reached INR 502.0 crore, up from INR 493.0 crore in Jun 2026 and INR 126.0 crore in Sep 2025.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management highlighted Q1 FY27 PAT grew 720% YoY to INR 493 Crore.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Jun 2026 PAT of INR 493.0 crore vs Jun 2025 PAT of INR 60.0 crore represents a 721.7% YoY increase.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management noted Q4 FY26 PAT grew over 6x YoY to INR 340 Crore.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Mar 2026 PAT stood at INR 340.0 crore against INR 47.0 crore in Mar 2025, up 623.4% YoY.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management aimed for FY26 credit cost of 5.5% to 6.0%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Credit cost ended at 6.74% in FY26, exceeding guidance due to elevated PAR and ECL rate increases.

bull.point: Q2 FY27 net profit reached a record INR 502 crore with operating profit margin expanding to 36.1%.
Management raised FY27 guidance across ROA to 5.2%-5.8% and ROE to 21%-24% following strong H1 performance.
5-year PAT CAGR stands at 42.8% and promoter holding remains strong at 63.83% as of Sep 2026.

bear.point: FY26 credit cost finished at 6.74%, missing initial guidance of 5.5%-6.0% due to asset quality slippages.
Cash flow from operations was negative at INR -2,770 crore in FY26, continuing a multi-year trend of operating cash deficits.
PAR accretion risks persist due to excess rainfall, floods in August-September, and drought conditions in Maharashtra.

watch.point: Impact of flood and drought conditions on H2 FY27 credit costs and PAR accretion.
NIM retention within 14.4%-14.7% target range following the October 50 bps interest rate reduction.
AUM growth momentum towards the full-year FY27 target of 20% to 25%.
